findings.evidence: The pattern `congrArg (fun C ↦ (C.u : ChangeRing ArrowRing)) (universalChange_map_map rightUnit)` plus `simp only [VariableChange.map_u, Units.coe_map, MonoidHom.coe_ofClass, …]` appears at lines 247–248, 259–261, 273–274 and 289–292.
findings.fix: Add simp lemmas to `ChangeRing` in Representable.lean: `map_universalChange_u : map f ((universalChange B).u : ChangeRing B) = (universalChange B').u`, and the `r`/`s`/`t` versions. Do the same for `coproduct` applied to each coordinate. The four proofs then become `simp [VariableChange.mul_def]; ring`.
findings.issue: `coproduct_u`, `coproduct_r`, `coproduct_s` and `coproduct_t` (lines ~243–293) each rebuild the same fact: the coordinate projections of `universalChange_map_map rightUnit` and `universalChange_map_coproduct`. Each uses `have := congrArg …` plus a `simp only` list naming internal unfolding lemmas (`Units.coe_map`, `MonoidHom.coe_ofClass`), which breaks on Mathlib renames.

findings.evidence: Lines 470–472: `have hu := congrArg (fun C : VariableChange R ↦ ((C.u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R)) (map_lift (W.specialize, C))` followed by `simp only [VariableChange.map_u, Units.coe_map_inv, MonoidHom.coe_ofClass] at hu`.
findings.fix: Add `ChangeRing.lift_universalChange_u : lift p ((universalChange B).u : ChangeRing B) = p.2.u` (and an inverse version, or derive it via `map_units_inv`) as simp lemmas. Then drop `hu` and close the goal with `simpa using hk`.
findings.issue: Same problem in `isIntegralModularForm_iff_rightUnit`. `hu` gets `lift p` on the universal `u⁻¹` through `congrArg` on `map_lift` and `simp only [VariableChange.map_u, Units.coe_map_inv, MonoidHom.coe_ofClass]`. The proof then ends with `simpa [hu] using hk` over unfolded data.

summary: Five proofs (`coproduct_u/r/s/t` and the reverse direction of `isIntegralModularForm_iff_rightUnit`) each re-derive the coordinates of the universal change of variables under `ChangeRing.map`/`ChangeRing.lift`. They do it with a brittle `congrArg` + `simp only [VariableChange.map_*, Units.coe_map, MonoidHom.coe_ofClass, …]` chain instead of shared simp lemmas.
